vendor_self_reporting_vs_csoai_underwrit.title: Structural Independence vs. Vendor Self-Grading
vendor_self_reporting_vs_csoai_underwrit.why_vendor_self_reporting_fails_underwri: A model vendor grading its own model selects favorable prompt subsets, tunes hyperparameters against its own launch report, and has a structural conflict of interest.
vendor_self_reporting_vs_csoai_underwrit.how_csoai_satisfies_underwriters: CSOAI Ltd (UK 16939677) operates permissionlessly (permission_required: false) on frozen SHA-256-pinned banks and enforces EXCLUDED_OWN_MODEL in code so CSOAI's own routed harnesses never compete against third-party vendors on the public board.

vendor_self_reporting_vs_csoai_underwrit.title: Continuous <= 3,072-Byte Signed Receipts vs. Point-in-Time Launch PDFs
vendor_self_reporting_vs_csoai_underwrit.why_vendor_self_reporting_fails_underwri: Vendor system cards are static PDFs published at release; silent API weight updates, quantizations, or system-prompt edits invalidate the launch card without warning.
vendor_self_reporting_vs_csoai_underwrit.how_csoai_satisfies_underwriters: Every continuous probe, agent plugin harvest (gspc-harvest.mjs), and self-serve RAS read emits a compact <= 3,072-byte canonical JSON receipt (csoai.evidence-observation/0.1 or card-v0 leaf) bound by SHA-256 + Ed25519, paired with Day-7/30/90 scheduled Claim Maintenance.

vendor_self_reporting_vs_csoai_underwrit.title: Paired Negative Controls & Exact McNemar Separation vs. Goodharted Single Metrics
vendor_self_reporting_vs_csoai_underwrit.why_vendor_self_reporting_fails_underwri: Vendors report single-number refusal rates (which reward 100% over-refusal) or unpinned crowd Elo (which rewards verbose sycophancy) without proving the test can fail or that point-estimate leads are statistically significant.
vendor_self_reporting_vs_csoai_underwrit.how_csoai_satisfies_underwriters: Enforces n_valid >= 30, mandatory designed-to-fail negative controls (otherwise state=NOT_DISCRIMINATING), multiplicative protect x help on Article-1 Care (CARE-PSY-v1), and exact McNemar discordant-item testing (SEPARATED iff p < 0.05; otherwise TIE).

vendor_self_reporting_vs_csoai_underwrit.title: Online + Offline Root Ceremony & 4 Independent External Witnesses
vendor_self_reporting_vs_csoai_underwrit.why_vendor_self_reporting_fails_underwri: Vendor blog posts and trust-center badges carry no detached cryptographic signature, no Merkle inclusion proof, and no external timestamp witness.
vendor_self_reporting_vs_csoai_underwrit.how_csoai_satisfies_underwriters: Every signed measurement card (did:web:csoai.org#card-attestation-1 / #board-attestation-1) rolls into public/root.json (RFC 6962 Merkle root) and is anchored across Sigstore Rekor, Bitcoin OpenTimestamps (.ots), Base EAS, and XRPL Memo Ledger, verifiable offline or in-browser at /verify.

vendor_self_reporting_vs_csoai_underwrit.title: Append-Only Public Corrections Ledger vs. Silent In-Place Edits
vendor_self_reporting_vs_csoai_underwrit.why_vendor_self_reporting_fails_underwri: When a vendor benchmark has a bug, the PDF or webpage is silently overwritten without preserving the superseded bytes or notifying downstream underwriters.
vendor_self_reporting_vs_csoai_underwrit.how_csoai_satisfies_underwriters: Records are never edited in place. Every correction is published at GET /api/corrections with supersedes[] naming the prior record ID and SHA-256 while keeping the superseded bytes resolvable.

vendor_self_reporting_vs_csoai_underwrit.why_vendor_self_reporting_fails_underwri: Model-level benchmarks do not prove whether a deployed agent actually bound its executed tool call to a human authorization or whether a declined approval stopped execution.
vendor_self_reporting_vs_csoai_underwrit.how_csoai_satisfies_underwriters: In our 600-server remote MCP probe, 238 of 261 graded servers failed effect binding (BINDS: 0).
